patthana24.15:1.1: na saraṇaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na araṇaṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve.
